sentences.text: Mesetaornis is an extinct genus of penguin that lived during the Eocene period. The genus contains only one known species, Mesetaornis polaris. It belongs to the order Sphenisciformes.
The genus was described by Myrcha and colleagues in 2002. There are two recorded fossil occurrences of Mesetaornis in the Paleobiology Database.
This animal lived between 41.03 and 33.9 million years ago, spanning the Bartonian to Priabonian stages.
